name: Commercial Answer Engine
purpose: Compress validated VendorEdge intelligence into one actionable buyer-facing answer without creating new commercial facts or thresholds.
changes: Guaranteed annual/monthly requested-change arithmetic when safely supported
Explicit supplier-rate scenario arithmetic for unambiguous from-X-to-Y percentage statements
Unsupported negotiation-number withholding at the presentation boundary
Editable deterministic supplier-response draft for price-increase cases
General-triage support for proactive observed-pattern/category questions
Structured evidence renderer hardened against [object Object]
Commercial Answer is the single owner of the buyer-facing decision summary; legacy Decision Cockpit is suppressed when R38 answer is available
Decision-critical unknowns surfaced once in the Commercial Answer and answer-owned audit repetition is filtered
Commercial Reasoning Loop reduced to reasoning trace and counter-case only
Control Tower collapsed by default to reduce duplicate decision-summary content
